race.comment: MISSILE MAGNATE (2) also resumes and has the class drop, with two trials behind him. Just fair in his latest trials, but this is easier and an inside draw can see him play a leading role on resumption. LA POTENZA (5) last-start Tamworth winner with a strong record around this trip. Finds the right race and can go back-to-back. ODE SO MUCH (4) resumes off a consistent last campaign and a Tamworth trial second. Expect he is primed for a big first-up performance. BLUE SUEDE HOOVES (8) has been poor in two runs back but comes through stronger provincial races, reaches peak fitness third-up and can improve sharply. Each-way.
